Lists cap at 50 items per kind, so counts are exact only while the truncation panel is green. Classification (expected venue closure vs defect) happens at review, not here.

panels.description: 1 when any capture_quality *_truncated flag is true: at least one evidence list is incomplete, so every count on this page becomes a lower bound. Freeze/quality checks fail until the complete underlying evidence is supplied.

panels.description: Engine warnings recorded in the report (metadata, replay or base-session caveats). Any non-zero value means read the report's warning text before trusting derived numbers.

options.content:
Pass conditions this page can only partially show (review plan §3):
- **Freeze integrity:** `excluded` and `unsealed` chunk counts must both be 0.
- **Lists complete:** the truncation panel must be green; capped lists undercount at 50 items.
- **Continuity:** every record/feed/clock anomaly itemized with paths and UTC position in the report.
- **Recovery:** recovered chunks are recovery loss, not coverage.
Counts here are list lengths — expected venue closures vs unexplained silences are classified at review.

panels.title: Liquidity and executable depth — per pair and requested size

panels.description: Sample counts per dated–perpetual pair and requested size: considered, entry-executable and full-round-trip-executable. Counts repeat across sizes and pair rows — never sum them; each series is the honest unit, and round-trip requires both legs executable in the reverse walk. Series identity: root_unit, leg_convention, dated/perpetual products, actual dated/perpetual leg contracts and requested_contracts. Plans that share a requested size but differ in leg quantities or direction stay separate — series are never merged, and no count or sum crosses plans.

panels.description: entry-executable / considered samples per pair and size. A missing line means considered was 0 (or the site has no pair series) — not a 0 % ratio; 0 % means samples existed but none was executable at that size. Sizes never collapse. Series identity: root_unit, leg_convention, dated/perpetual products, actual dated/perpetual leg contracts and requested_contracts. Plans that share a requested size but differ in leg quantities or direction stay separate — series are never merged, and no count or sum crosses plans.

Metadata schedule only: never settlement evidence and never a measured expiry cycle. panels.description: 56-day reference target (G1) from the published report config. A target, not a measurement: audited covered seconds come from the review's interval-union table, never from this number.
panels.title: Review target — days

panels.description: 2-cycle reference target (G2). No cycles-observed metric exists anywhere; observing a cycle needs frozen metadata transition evidence at review.
panels.title: Review target — dated cycles

options.content:
**G1 — coverage:** target **56 days** of audited capture per site. Raw span and interval union on this page are elapsed evidence only; passing G1 requires the review's interval-union/subtraction audit (plan §4).
**G2 — dated cycles:** target **≥ 2 observed** cycles per site. **NOT ASSESSED here** — no metric publishes a cycles-observed value; count transitions from frozen metadata at review (plan §5).
**Prerequisites (unverified, plan §7):** venue fee schedule, funding settlement semantics, capital/margin terms, eligibility, and contract multipliers from frozen metadata. Until supplied, economics stays scenario-labelled. A short site extends on its own evidence; never borrow coverage from the other site.

panels.title: Review gates — what is and is not assessed here

options.content:
**Scope.** Instantaneous gauge snapshots from the market-research metrics exporter, derived from each site's committed `report.json` (the report commit marker, written last; invalid, cross-site or hash-mismatched reports publish nothing). Sites are never pooled and quotes are single-site. `N/A` on any panel means *unknown or not evaluated* — never zero.

**Dashboards.** [Paper economics (scenarios)](/d/market-research-economics) · [Capture health (recorder)](/d/market-recorder-capture) · [Measurement review plan](https://github.com/paulkiernan/diff-logic-cells/blob/main/research/MEASUREMENT_REVIEW_PLAN.md)

**Limits.** Span and interval union are raw elapsed evidence, not audited coverage. Quality counts are capped list lengths. Pair statistics are quote snapshots at sample instants, per pair and per requested size — not profit, not additive volume, and no annualized return is claimed anywhere. Single-site L2 quotes; no venue or NTP synchronisation is claimed.
